def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    colors = [color]
    # The non-background object defines a stamp; find matching all-zero locations.
    if not colors: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = colors[0]
    pts = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0, c0 = min(i for i,j in pts), min(j for i,j in pts)
    shape = {(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pts}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0 <= i < h and 0 <= j < w and grid[i][j] == 0 for i,j in cells):
                for i,j in cells: out[i][j] = color
    return out
